Wicker Toboggan Sled Ride for One, Two or Three people. 1 Person 30,00 EUR 2 Persons 40,00 EUR 3 Persons 60,00 EUR SCHEDULES Monday to Saturday From 09:00 to 18:00 Monte Departures Location closes at 17:45 Livramento Arrival Location closes at 18:15 **We do not accept online reservations or bookings. Tickets are purchased on-site and for the same day only. We may close early due to the number of people waiting with tickets or adverse weather conditions.** ***In case of rain or wet ground, we do not provide rides for 3 people.*** CLOSED DAYS August: 14th and 15th Festivities in honour of Our Lady of Monte CLOSED December: 25th Christmas day CLOSED January 1st First day of the year CLOSED Holy Week Good Friday and Easter Sunday CLOSED Home About us History Prices Locations Contacts Carreiros do Monte Departure location: Caminho do Monte, Entrada 151, Porta 4 9050-288 Monte Funchal - Madeira Portugal Google Maps Arrival location: Caminho do Monte nº82/84 9050-288 Livramento Funchal - Madeira Portugal Google Maps Partners: Copyright © 2026 Associação dos Carreiros do Monte.
